title: Fujita’s freeness conjecture

result.label: Fujita’s freeness conjecture
result.statement: Proves Fujita's freeness conjecture at its sharp bound in every dimension: for a smooth projective complex variety X of dimension n and an ample line bundle L , the adjoint KX+mL is globally generated for every integer m n+1.
result.roleNote: The family's stated result in the release.
